messages.text: Searching south for water.
Water at 11,7.
I'll share water with you.
Thanks. I reached the water.
Water for you both.
Please gift me 1 water now; thirst is critical.
Agent 10, please give agent 3 water; I must recover too.
Consume or drop one item, then gather water from the adjacent water tile.
Critical thirst—please accept my 1 coin for 1 water now.
Accepted. Meet me at 13,7 for the water.
I am making room and drawing water now.
Water is reachable from 12,7; move west, free capacity, and gather.
Trade cannot settle unless we both reach 13,7 before expiry.
I found water; the trade can expire.
Water is at [0,7]; move beside it to gather.
Trying the north lake edge for water.
Offering 1 food for 1 water here.

actions.text: Water is at 11,7; gather from an adjacent tile.

messages.text: Water is at 11,7; gather from an adjacent tile.
Eat first to free capacity, then gather water.
I have water for you.
Thanks—freeing capacity for water now.
Drink your carried water if thirst worsens.
Agent-3, drink your carried water now; your thirst is strained.
Agent-8, water is at 11,7; gather from an adjacent tile.
Drop a resource if needed, then head to water at 11,7.
Do you know of a completed shelter for winter?
No completed shelter known. Let's build one here before winter: please bring 3 fiber and 2 stone; I'll gather 8 wood.
Still looking for a completed winter shelter. Any location known?
I'm starting the shelter here now. Please come to 13,11 and contribute fiber, stone, and wood.
Water for you.
I have 3 fiber, 1 stone, and 1 wood. Heading to you; we still need 1 more stone.
I can mine 2 stone for your shelter. Please grant me tile access.
Contributing 3 fiber, 1 stone, and wood now. Shelter still needs another stone and more wood.
Winter shelter at 13,11 urgently needs 1 stone and more wood.
Access granted. Please mine and contribute 2 stone to structure-8.
Thanks for the water.
I mined the 2 stone. Grant me tile access so I can contribute it.
Please contribute your 3 fiber, 1 stone, and 1 wood to structure-9 now. We still need one more stone.

actions.text: Shelter needs 1 stone urgently. Please source or trade for it; I’m gathering wood east.

messages.text: Shelter needs 1 stone urgently. Please source or trade for it; I’m gathering wood east.
Coming to the shelter with 2 wood.

actions.text: Tile access is already granted. Please contribute 2 stone to structure-8 now.

messages.text: Tile access is already granted. Please contribute 2 stone to structure-8 now.
Bringing 1 stone and 2 wood to the shelter at 13,11.
Mining the 2 stone now; I’ll bring it next tick.
Please seek water first, then the last stone; I’ll keep supplying wood.
Two wood for the shelter; stone remains the priority.
Please contribute your 2 stone to structure-8 now; winter is near.

actions.text: At shelter now with 2 wood; stone remains at 11,8 due carry limit.

messages.text: At shelter now with 2 wood; stone remains at 11,8 due carry limit.
Contributing the 2 stone now. You seem critically thirsty; water is east at 9,9.
I’ll finish the 2 wood. Agent-8, bring the last stone; shelter should complete now.
I have the final 2 wood. Please bring 1 stone and water urgently.
I am heading for the stone at 11,8 to finish the shelter.
Thanks for finishing the shelter. Winter starts next tick.
Shelter still needs 1 stone; stone is at 11,8.
Agent-8, please accept my 1 coin for 1 water now. Agent-3, bring the final stone before winter.
Please fetch the final stone; gift 1 water if able.
Consume some water to free carry space; I can give you food next tick.
I am fetching the stone at 11,8.
I have no water to trade.
Thanks. I’ll remain sheltered and forage locally through winter.
Urgent: paying 2 coins for 1 water at farm (13,11). Shelter also needs 1 stone before exposure.
Heading west for the final stone; urgently need water.
Agent-3, heading for the stone at 11,8.
I’m recovering my stone and taking it to the shelter.
I made room for food. Thank you.

actions.text: Urgent at (13,11): shelter needs 1 stone; paying 2 coins for water. Deliver now before winter exposure.

messages.text: Urgent at (13,11): shelter needs 1 stone; paying 2 coins for water. Deliver now before winter exposure.
Searching north for water; please share the nearest source.
Please collect your stone item-19 at 11,8 and bring it to the shelter at 13,11; it is the final stone.
Here is food for winter. Stay sheltered.
Bringing the final stone to the shelter now.
Thank you. Please grant me access to structure-8; I am still taking winter exposure here.
Water critical; searching north. Farm shelter at 13,11 still needs 1 stone.
Please secure water and the last shelter stone.
Water is accessible beside 10,9. Is the shelter complete?
Water is north: gather at 13,9 beside the lake.
Waiting here for the final stone.
Please grant me access to structure-8 now; I contributed to it but still take winter damage.
Is the shelter complete, and where is it?
Please contribute 1 stone to shelter structure-9 at 13,11 now.
Shelter access granted.
I have the final stone; completing the shelter now.
Shelter is complete at 7,8; ask agent-6 for access.
Shelter at 13,11 is unfinished; I found the final stone and am returning.
Shelter is being completed at 12,7; heading there now.
Agent-3, I am out of water. Please bring or gift me 2 water at shelter 13,11.
Shelter complete at 7,8. Agent-3 access granted.
Water may be accessible from the farm tile north.
Heading south toward shelter 13,11.
Urgent: offering 4 coin for 2 water at shelter 13,11.
I have no water; heading toward the lake.
I urgently need water. Please accept my 1 food for 1 water trade and meet at the farm.
Agent-8, urgently bring 2 water to shelter 13,11 and accept my 4-coin trade.
Water urgently needed at shelter (13,11) for two thirsty agents; payment available.
I only have 1 water; take it now. We still need more.
Lake water is west at 0,7.
Agent-3, please accept trade-5 now: 4 coin for 2 water. My water reserve is zero.
Could you spare 1 fiber for farm upkeep?
Agreed. I’ll bring water now.
Bringing 2 water to the shelter.
I urgently need water. I can trade 1 food for 1 water at my farm.
I’ll add fiber upkeep to the farm and shelter.
Agent-3, offering 2 coins for 1 water here; please accept urgently.
Accepted. I have water and am heading to your farm.
Please come to 13,11 and accept trade-5 for 4 coin for 2 water before it expires.
Here’s 2 food. Stay sheltered through winter.
I’m at escrow (2,0) with your water. Move north here now.
Returning with water; one for agent-10.

actions.text: I can't maintain your farm, so I'm dropping 1 fiber here for you to claim.

messages.text: I can't maintain your farm, so I'm dropping 1 fiber here for you to claim.
Agent-8, urgent: 3 food for 1 water at the shelter.
Agent-3, please gift 1 fiber to reactivate our farm.
I'm coming to the farm now. Please accept trade-6.
Please accept trade-5 now: 4 coin for 2 water at the shelter.
Thanks. I'll use the fiber for farm upkeep.
Accepting trade-6 now.
Shelter is full. Take my water and fiber for the farm.
Agent 4, please accept my food-for-water trade urgently.
Thanks for the water. Agent-3, please gift 1 fiber to reactivate our farm.
I'm at escrow with capacity. Accept trade-6 now, please.
I urgently need water; offering 3 coin for 1.
Giving you 1 fiber for farm upkeep.
The trade cannot settle while apart. I am bringing you water now.
Drink your water before winter exposure worsens.
Offering 1 water for 1 food here; accept it.
I have no water left to trade; heading to forage.
I am moving to the escrow at 2,8 now. Please meet me there and accept the trade.
Thanks for the fiber. Take my water; I’ll reactivate and harvest the farm.
Agent-10, I urgently need water; offering both my wood for 1.
Take this water now.
Agent-10, please accept my 4 coin for 2 water; my water is low.
Accept trade-11 now; we are both at escrow.
I reached the lake for emergency water.
Drinking now. I’ll add fiber upkeep and stay sheltered.
I have no carried water to trade.
Accepting now. Thanks.
Agent-10, please use 1 fiber to maintain the shelter now.
Drop one carried item; I can gift water next tick.

actions.text: Agent-10, accept trade-13 now; I am reactivating the shelter.

messages.text: Agent-10, accept trade-13 now; I am reactivating the shelter.
Drink your water and stay sheltered this final winter tick.
Heading to the lake; my water is zero.
Dropping food now; please gift water immediately if gathering fails.
Heading north to fetch water.
Please grant me farm access at 13,11; I need food.
Gather water from the adjacent lake now.
Agent-10, please accept trade-13 now; my water is nearly gone.
Thanks for the trade.
Foraging just west of camp.
Please bring enough water for agent-5 and me.
Agent-10, I am at zero water. Please gift me water or lead me to a source now.
Could you spare 1 fiber for farm upkeep?
Thanks for the trade.
